<!--
Upstream preprocessing of the eye-tracking data: screens trackloss, interpolates
blinks and smooths the raw pupil signal (via the `gazer` / `saccades` toolchain and
the local `pupInterp()` helper), producing the per-trial pupil traces used by the
analysis notebook (../drug_effects.Rmd). Raw eye-tracking data are not public (see README).
-->

```{r include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Data root (the raw eye-tracking / behavioural files live under here; not public).
# Defaults to the working directory; override with the PDPHARM_DIR environment variable.
projectDir <- Sys.getenv("PDPHARM_DIR", unset = getwd())

source("pupInterp.R")   # local blink-interpolation / smoothing helper (same folder)


results_dir <- file.path(projectDir,'results','beh','CW', 'Colorwheel')
results_dir_g <- file.path(projectDir, 'results','beh','CW')

cw_data <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir_g,'Colorwheel','rawDatamat.csv'), header = F)
cw_names <- c('subject', 'session', 'dev','rt', 'setSize', 'type', 'col_pie','lureDif','thetaCorrect','tau','thetaLure' ,'signedDev','trial','block')
names(cw_data) <- cw_names
type_order <- cw_data %>% dplyr::filter(subject == 2, session ==1) %>% dplyr::select(type,setSize)

#data=read.csv(file=directory,header=T,sep=',') 
#data=readMat(directory)
gaze_raw <- data.table::fread(file.path(results_dir,'rawPupil.csv')) # reads in large datasets quickly
#rename according to gazer requirements
gaze_raw <- gaze_raw %>% rename(x = xPos, y = yPos, subject = subNo)

gaze_data <- as_tibble(gaze_raw)
```


## data loss
determines the on/off screen status of each sample, computes the proportion of trackloss by trial and participant, and filters out trials and subjects that pass a user-defined threshold (this filtering can be omitted by setting the threshold to 1.0)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
screenX <- 1920
screenY <- 1080
samplingRateHz <- 500

# function requires time to consistently increase, while we have some inconsistencies. I artificially adapted it to increase by 2 till the end of the matrix
gaze_data$time <- seq(2,2*dim(gaze_data)[1],2)
#fix trial repetition so that trial goes from 1 to 64
gaze_data$trial[gaze_data$block == 2] <- gaze_data$trial[gaze_data$block == 2] + max(gaze_data$trial)
#turns 0s to Nan
gaze_data$pupil[gaze_data$pupil == 0] <- NA

#removes participants for whom data is missing based on threshold.
pup_missing <- count_missing_pupil(gaze_data, missingthresh = .3)


```

Remove values based on histogram (Mathot) move this step higher up: figure out if and when this step is necessary. Interpolation does not work well if this done first, so do not run

```{r}
puphist <- ggplot(pup_missing, aes(x = pupil)) + geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..),
    colour = "green", binwidth = 0.5)  + ylim(0,5000)+
    xlab("Pupil Size") + ylab("Count") + theme_bw() + geom_vline(xintercept = 2500, linetype="dotted") +geom_vline(xintercept = 6200, linetype="dotted")
print(puphist)

pup_outliers<-pup_missing %>% filter (pupil > 2000 & pupil < 6000) # based on visual inspection

pup_sdabovebelow<-pup_outliers %>% group_by(subject,session, trial) %>% mutate(pupilmeanabove=mean(pupil, na.rm=TRUE)+ 3*sd(pupil, na.rm=TRUE), pupilmeanbelow=mean(pupil, na.rm=TRUE)-3*sd(pupil, na.rm=TRUE))
pup_sd1<-pup_sdabovebelow %>% subset(pup_sdabovebelow$pupil< pup_sdabovebelow$pupilmeanabove & pup_sdabovebelow$pupil > pup_sdabovebelow$pupilmeanbelow)

```
Data driven gaze correction

```{r echo=TRUE}
pup_missing$pupil[is.na(pup_missing$pupil)] <- 0 #turn back to 0, so I don't have to change pupInterp
#model <- lmer(pupil~ x + y +(1|subject), data=pup_missing)
mod = lm(pupil ~ x + y, data = pup_missing)#Create the linear regression
summary(mod)
pup_missing$pup_resi <- mod$residuals

for (n in 1:32){
a <- pup_missing %>% filter(subject == 34, session ==1, trial==n)
plot(a$pupil, pch = 16, col = "red", ylim=c(0,9000))
points(a$pup_resi, col = 'green')
}
```
gazer interpolation NOT INCLUDED
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
pup_extend<- pup_missing %>% group_by(subject, session, trial) %>% mutate(extendpupil=extend_blinks(pupil, fillback=50, fillforward=50))
pup_interp<-interpolate_pupil(pup_extend, extendblinks=TRUE)

```

interpolation based on hershman

```{r}

pup_missing$pup_interp <- NA
#pup_missing$pupil[is.na(pup_missing$pupil)] <- 0 #turn back to 0, so I don't have to change pupInterp
pup_missing$pup_resi[pup_missing$pupil == 0] <- 0

msToSmooth <- 10 
pup_type <- 'resi' #interpolate raw pupil or residuals?
pup_missing$pup_interp <- pupInterp(pup_missing, samplingRateHz, 'linear', msToSmooth)

```

Z score pupil
```{r}

smooth_data<- smooth_data%>% dplyr::group_by(subject)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(pupil_z = (smooth_pup - mean(smooth_pup)) / sd(smooth_pup))
```
Mathot histogram again
```{r}
puphist <- ggplot(smooth_data, aes(x = pupil_z)) + geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..),
    colour = "green", binwidth = 0.5)  + 
    xlab("Pupil Size") + ylab("Count") + theme_bw() 
print(puphist)

```

```{r}

 save('smooth_data',file=file.path(results_dir,'smooth_pupil_data.RData'))
```

summary
```{r}
pup_sum_phase <- smooth_data %>% dplyr::group_by(subject,session,trial,phase,type) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean_pup = mean(pupil_z), max_pup = max(pupil_z))

pup_sum <- pup_sum_phase %>% dplyr::group_by(subject,session,phase) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean_pup = mean(mean_pup), max_pup = max(max_pup))

pup_sum_type <- pup_sum_phase %>% dplyr::group_by(subject,session,phase,type) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean_pup = mean(mean_pup), max_pup = max(max_pup))


phase_labels <- c('encoding','delay','interference')
#pup_sum <- pup_sum %>% dplyr::mutate(phase = recode(phase, '1' = 'encoding', '2' = 'delay', '3' = 'interference'))

sur3 <- ggplot(pup_sum %>% dplyr::filter(session == 1),aes(y=mean_pup, x=factor(phase),fill=factor(phase)))+ geom_boxplot()+geom_jitter()+ theme_classic() + labs(y = "Mean pupil size (z-scored)") + theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12))+ scale_x_discrete('Task phase',labels = phase_labels)+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 17),axis.text = element_text(size = 16),legend.position="none")+ scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2")

sur4 <- ggplot(pup_sum %>% dplyr::filter(session == 1),aes(y=max_pup, x=factor(phase),fill=factor(phase)))+ geom_boxplot()+geom_jitter()+ theme_classic() + labs(y = "Max pupil size (z-scored)") + theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12))+ scale_x_discrete('Task phase',labels = phase_labels)+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 17),axis.text = element_text(size = 16),legend.position="none")+ scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2")

sur5 <-ggplot(pup_sum_type %>% dplyr::filter(session == 1),aes(y=mean_pup, x=factor(phase),fill=factor(type)))+ geom_boxplot()+geom_jitter()+ theme_classic() + labs(y = "Mean pupil size (z-scored)") + theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12))+ scale_x_discrete('Task phase',labels = phase_labels)+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 17),axis.text = element_text(size = 16))+ scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2")


ggarrange(sur3,sur4, sur5, ncol=2, nrow=2)
```
Bin time course
```{r}
#bin time
time_breaks <- seq(0,2,0.2)
time_labels <- as.character(time_breaks[-1])
smooth_data <- smooth_data %>%  dplyr::mutate(time_bin = cut(time2, breaks = time_breaks, right = T))

pup_sum_time_bin <- smooth_data %>% dplyr::group_by(subject,session, phase,type, time_bin) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean_pup = mean(pupil_z), max_pup = max(smooth_pup))

time_bin_sum <- summarySEwithin(pup_sum_time_bin %>% filter(!is.na(time_bin)), measurevar = 'mean_pup', withinvars = c("time_bin", 'phase', 'type'),idvar="subject",na.rm = T)

default_alpha <- 0.6
#accuracy by Phase
mean_time_bin_gen <- ggplot(data=pup_sum_time_bin, aes(x=as.numeric(time_bin), y=mean_pup, ymin=mean_pup-se, ymax=mean_pup+se, color= phase, fill=phase)) + scale_fill_manual(values= phase_labels, name= "Phase")+scale_color_manual(values= phase_labels, name= 'Phase')+
  geom_line(size=1) + theme_classic() + geom_ribbon(alpha=default_alpha) + labs(y = "Accuracy",x='Stimulus number') +  #scale_x_continuous( breaks = 1:length(bin_interval_labels),labels = bin_interval_labels) +
  theme_classic()+theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 20),axis.text = element_text(size = 16))

ggplot(data=time_bin_sum, aes(x=as.numeric(time_bin), y=mean_pup, ymin=mean_pup-se, ymax=mean_pup+se, color= type, fill=type)) + 
    geom_line(size=1) + geom_ribbon(alpha=default_alpha) + labs(y = "Mean pupil",x='Time (s)') + theme_classic() + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 20),axis.text = element_text(size = 16)) + facet_wrap(~phase)  + scale_x_continuous( breaks = 1:10, labels = time_labels)+ scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2")+scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Dark2')
```
